397 -> 391, and the floor was never right either: measured 398 at e099da1b159, the commit that set it to 397.

Seven of the eight units are 9071aa2f2ca reaching a scope it did not measure.
That change added `fetchall` to the TYPE_CHECKING block of BaseCursor -- the base
had always required the family (`fetchscalar` calls `self.fetchone()`) and
declared half of it -- and py_typecheck.yml runs mypy TWICE, over six packages
against `mypy` and over odoo.tools against this floor. Only the first was
re-measured, so the improvement landed here unbanked, which an exact ratchet
rejects in the falling direction exactly as it rejects a regression:

    odoo/tools/cloc.py       "BaseCursor" has no attribute "fetchall"   x4
    odoo/tools/translate.py  "BaseCursor" has no attribute "fetchall"   x3

The eighth is the floor`s own birth: 397 was banked against a tree that measured
398, so this lane has been red since e099da1b159 in the rising direction too.
Both halves are settled by one absolute reading rather than another delta.

Measured the way py_typecheck.yml prescribes: mypy 2.3.0 and NOTHING ELSE in the
venv, --no-incremental, `-p odoo.tools`, in a detached worktree, counted with
grep -cE ": error:" -- which agrees with mypy`s own summary line (391 in 53
files).
